note: The text a person edits, with its links (spec/translation-file/editing.md). A state is {text, passages [{start,length,origin?,open?,order?}], links (passage i <-> link i), lost [{words,reason,origin?,order?,link?}], unlinked, new_forms, format2, damaged}; positions are UTF-16 units of the clear text; a passage with no origin has its own words as origin. `step` replays a SEQUENCE of texts, one Step each: a case that matters both ways exists « step by step » and « in one step » (k2, k9) so the stated degradation is held by a case. `casing: first-letter` is the executor's stand-in for the caller's case functions. Answers are partial: a case names what it pins.
